thesis: The site is the heating-season calendar: a horizontal strip of months runs through every screen, and each section is the month that matters most for that piece of work.

signature.name: season rail
signature.summary: A horizontal month strip appears in the hero peek, as a sticky sub-nav on desktop, and as a watermark numeral in each section header; services, reviews and the footer are pinned to their month.

motion.intro: Season rail slides in from left; September watermark fades up; woodshed photo unclips. H1 readable before motion completes.
stories: Season rail pins on desktop >=640px as you scroll through monthly sections; active month highlights and watermark cross-fades.
motion.hover: Hairline grows from left via scaleX, 200ms, on links and cards.
